Messages.Body:
On 10 Nov 2004 13:43:01 -0800, Emmit Svenson <emmits...@hotmail.com>
wrote:

> Say that a vampire with a tapped Corporeal Reservoir is Banished. If
> the vampire is brought back into the controlled region, is the
> Corporeal Reservoir untapped? If a vampire with a tapped Corporeal
> Reservoir played Descent into Darkness, would the Corporeal Reservoir
> be untapped when it reentered play?

I think that being tapped is a possible condition of some cards. The
default
is not being tapped (e.g., being untapped). So I think that cards retain
their
cards and counters but not any other status (like, being tapped or not).

--
Bye,

Daneel
